name: Klick
tagline: A fully automatic camera that shoots RAW bursts and merges them into one clean photo.
description: Klick is a point-and-shoot camera with nothing to set. Press the shutter and it captures a burst of RAW frames, chosen automatically from the scene: a few short frames in daylight, up to twelve in the dark, always exposed to protect highlights and limited by your hand shake. A native Rust engine on your phone aligns the frames, merges them to cut noise, develops the RAW with proper colour, lifts shadows and tames highlights, then denoises, sharpens and saves a JPEG. The reference frame can be kept as a DNG. Everything runs on your phone, with no ads and no tracking.
